notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery and Pemmin's Aura attached to the same creature.
The creature with Pemmin's Aura and Elemental Mastery attached has a power of at least two and does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate the creature with Pemmin's Aura and Elemental Mastery attached by tapping it, creating at least two 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste.
Activate an Elemental token by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping the creature.
Repeat.
